tool_args.rationale: The five pilots are positive and confined to short horizons, while the proposed dual-horizon adaptation predicts a long-horizon reversal. The slow-horizon discriminating probe is the cost-effective observation needed before fitting and confirming the quantitative law at the target horizon.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a short-horizon smooth siphon from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilots have H≤0.48, so they cannot identify the long-timescale adaptation or establish behavior at the target H=21.1.
More fine-grained short-horizon data would not resolve the key long-horizon identifiability ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to distinguishing the proposed temporal mechanisms and is explicitly unnecessary.
